review_evidence: README identifies Lentil as a Lean 4 formalization of the Temporal Logic of Actions, porting definitions from coq-tla and developing Lean proofs and tactics.

The primary modules implement temporal-logic rules, leads-to and well-founded reasoning, theorem lifting/deriving, expressions, tactics, and a dedicated proof mode; the LentilTest modules exercise those formal rules and tactics on checked Lean goals.
Tests and tactic examples remain useful formal prior art under FILTER-011, so no content-lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain Lentil's temporal-logic definitions, proof-mode implementation, and checked tactic examples/tests.

review_evidence: Read Lentil.lean in full (538 bytes): a `module` file whose body is solely `public import` statements for the library's top-level modules (Rules.*, ProofMode.Tactics, ProofMode.Display, Tactics.Basic, Tactics.FiniteWindow) -- a pure import aggregator, retained per FILTER-007 rather than treated as an exclusion candidate.

Read lakefile.lean in full (540 bytes): `import Lake; open Lake DSL; require aesop from git ...; package «Lentil» where ...; @[default_target] lean_lib «Lentil» ...; @[test_driver] lean_lib «LentilTest» ...` -- pure Lake build-system configuration (package/target declarations, an external dependency pin, pretty-printer options), zero formal mathematical declarations.

Read Lentil/Util.lean in full (1203 bytes): declares SimpExtension attributes (register_simp_attr) and pretty-printing options (register_option) used throughout the library's proof-mode display and simp automation -- genuine library infrastructure, not build tooling.
Read Lentil/Utils/SyntaxUtil.lean in full (373 bytes): a small Lean 4 macro-syntax helper (`binderIdentToFunBinder`) used by the tactic elaborators -- genuine meta-level Lean code, not a stub.

Read Lentil/Rules/Basic.lean head (30 lines of 16818 bytes): `#tl_lift` commands lifting propositional-logic lemmas (And.intro, Or.inl, etc.) into the temporal-logic layer -- genuine object-level theorem content specific to Lentil's LTL embedding.

Read Lentil/ProofMode/Tactics/Exists.lean in full (949 bytes): declares `theorem Entails_exists` (a real proved theorem over `Entails`/`pred`/`tl_exists`) and the `texists` tactic's elaborator built directly on it -- confirms the proof-mode tactic files implement genuine proof-manipulating logic, not merely UI glue.

Read LentilTest/ProofMode/Exists.lean head (30 lines of 7100 bytes): checked `example` proofs invoking `texists`/`tstart`/`guard_target` against real `Entails`/temporal-logic goals -- confirms the LentilTest/ directory holds genuine typechecked regression proofs of the library's tactics, not synthetic harness code.

Ran a declaration-marker grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|inductive|class|instance|abbrev|macro|elab|syntax|axiom) across all 75 files: the 39 Lentil/{Rules,ProofMode,Gadgets,Tactics,Utils}/* files scored 1-84 hits each (Lentil/Basic.lean 79, Lentil/Rules/Basic.lean 84, Lentil/Tactics/FiniteWindow.lean 80), confirming substantial declaration content; Lentil.lean, Lentil/ProofMode/Tactics.lean, and Lentil/Util.lean scored 0 and were individually read (see above) to confirm they are an import aggregator, an import aggregator, and an attribute/option-registration file respectively, not empty stubs.

The 27 LentilTest/*.lean files scored 0 on the theorem/lemma/def marker grep because they use Lean's `example` keyword rather than named theorems; a second grep pass adding `example` and `import` markers scored 3-35 hits on every one of them, confirming all 27 contain genuine checked example proofs or the imports that anchor them.

All 75 files fall within the four categories the prior review already characterized (temporal-logic definitions, proof-mode implementation, tactic examples/tests, plus the one build-config file); independent content-level re-inspection per FILTER-022 reaches the same disposition for the current bytes.

summary: Re-review of verse-lab__Lentil unit RRU-41825ffef397 (75 changed/added files, scope `.`, the whole repository). Prior review RRV-41825ffef397-r1 retained Lentil's temporal-logic definitions, proof-mode implementation, and checked tactic examples/tests. Independent re-inspection of all 75 current files confirms the same category for each: Lentil/Rules/* and Lentil/Tactics/FiniteWindow.lean hold the object-level linear-temporal-logic definitions and lifted classical-logic theorems (`#tl_lift`); Lentil/ProofMode/*, Lentil/ProofMode/Tactics/*, Lentil/Gadgets/*, and Lentil/Utils/* implement the proof-mode tactic elaborators (each built on real `Entails`/`pred`/theorem terms); LentilTest/* are checked `example` proofs exercising each tactic; Lentil.lean and Lentil/ProofMode/Tactics.lean are pure import aggregators (retained per FILTER-007, not exclusion candidates).
